tfa.title: Two-step sign-in
tfa.lead: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
tfa.wrong: The code is not right. Try the newest code from the app.
tfa.recovery_hint: Lost your phone? Enter one of your recovery codes instead.
tfa.admin_lead: Your account sees every clinic: protect it with a code from an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator…) after your password.
tfa.step1: Install an authenticator app on your phone.
tfa.step2: Scan this QR code with it (or type the key below).
tfa.codes_lead: Keep them somewhere safe: each one signs you in once if you lose your phone. They are shown only now.
